flashcard.title: 👋 Welcome
flashcard.definition:
Welcome to Flashy!

This app helps you remember vocabulary using spaced repetition.

Swipe through these tutorial cards to learn how everything works.

When you're ready, start adding your own words!
flashcard.example: I would like to welcome you all to the conference.
flashcard.collocation: warm welcome, welcome guests, welcome a suggestion

flashcard.title: 📚 What is a Flashcard?
flashcard.definition:
A flashcard contains a word or phrase on one side and its meaning on the other.

Reviewing flashcards regularly is one of the most effective ways to remember new vocabulary.
flashcard.example: I keep a flashcard on my desk to remind me of the new vocabulary.
flashcard.collocation: digital flashcards, make flashcards, flip a flashcard

flashcard.title: ➕ Add Your First Card
flashcard.definition:
Tap the + button to create your own flashcard.

You can add:
• Word
• Definition
• Example
• Pronunciation
• Audio
flashcard.example: Please add your name to the top of the list.
flashcard.collocation: add value, add an item, add details

flashcard.title: ⭐ Review Buttons
flashcard.definition:
After each review you'll choose one of four buttons:

Again → I forgot
Hard → Difficult
Good → I remembered
Easy → Very easy

Your choice determines when you'll see the card again.
flashcard.example: I need to review my notes before the big exam tomorrow.
flashcard.collocation: review a document, write a review, performance review

flashcard.title: 🧠 Spaced Repetition
flashcard.definition:
The app schedules reviews automatically.

Cards you know well appear less often.
Cards you forget appear sooner.

This helps you remember more while studying less.
flashcard.example: Spaced repetition is proven to help with long-term memory retention.
flashcard.collocation: spaced repetition software, use spaced repetition, spaced repetition system

flashcard.title: 🔥 Daily Streak
flashcard.definition:
Review at least one card every day to keep your streak alive.

Consistency is more important than studying for long hours.
flashcard.example: I have a 10-day streak on my language learning app.
flashcard.collocation: winning streak, maintain a streak, streak continues

flashcard.title: 📊 Dashboard
flashcard.definition:
The Dashboard shows:
• Today's reviews
• Remaining cards
• Learning progress
• Upcoming reviews
• Estimated study time
flashcard.example: The dashboard shows that I have 20 cards due for review today.
flashcard.collocation: main dashboard, view the dashboard, dashboard display

flashcard.title: 🔍 Search & Filter
flashcard.definition:
Use Search to quickly find any word.

Filter your cards by status or category to stay organized.
flashcard.example: I want to search for all the words I marked as difficult.
flashcard.collocation: search for information, search the database, quick search

flashcard.title: 📥 Import Your Vocabulary
flashcard.definition:
Already have a vocabulary list?

Import your words and start reviewing immediately instead of creating cards one by one.
flashcard.example: You can import your Excel file directly into the app.
flashcard.collocation: import data, import files, import from a device

flashcard.title: 🎉 You're Ready!
flashcard.definition:
That's it!

You're ready to build your own vocabulary collection.

Good luck, and happy learning!

You can delete these tutorial cards whenever you want.
flashcard.example: Once you have finished the tutorial, you are ready to start learning.
flashcard.collocation: ready to go, get ready, ready for use
